mapper.insert: INSERT INTO memory_extraction_log (conversation_id, user_id, status, error_message, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, UTC_TIMESTAMP())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM memory_extraction_log WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM memory_extraction_log WHERE status = 'failed' ORDER BY processed_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
